description: This file contains C++ source code implementing classes and functions related to a plugin service in the Thunder framework, including request handling, service notifications, file serving, and network interface configuration.

classes.name: PluginHost::Request

classes.name: PluginHost::Service
classes.description: Handles service notifications and file serving functionalities within the plugin host.

classes.description: Factory class for creating shell jobs.
